features: Give new life to your TV – Fire TV Stick 4K enhances your TV with endless entertainment, fast performance, and Alexa+ intelligence, plus a new Fire TV Remote and Wi-Fi 6 support.
Watch in vivid 4K with HDR10+ – Make the most of your 4K TV’s picture quality. You’ll see rich colors, deep contrast, and sharp details, whether it's a stunning nature doc or your favorite rom-com.
Easier than ever to set up – Plug into a TV’s HDMI port to stream anywhere. With Direct Power, it’s powered by the TV (no wall adapter necessary).

All-new Fire TV Remote – Enjoy an intuitive layout with TV power/volume controls. Search with the navigation ring and jump to specific scenes. Dedicated buttons for the Shortcut Panel, Fire TV experience menu, and Live TV get you there in one click.

Find it fast – The Fire TV experience gets you to what you’re looking for, whether it’s shows, games, music, or smart home controls. Browse dedicated content categories, pin more of your favorite apps, and turn your display into a work of art.

All your apps in one place – Prime Video, Netflix, YouTube, Disney+, Apple TV, HBO Max, Hulu, Peacock, Paramount+, and thousands more. Easily find what's next from hundreds of thousands of movies and TV episodes, including free, ad-supported content. Subscription fees may apply.
Smarter picks with Alexa+ – Press the voice remote button and talk naturally to get personalized recommendations for what to watch, manage your smart home, or dive into virtually any topic.
Control your smart home – Alexa checks your Ring cameras, dims the lights, and more.
Bluetooth listening – Connect your Bluetooth headphones for private listening to watch TV without disturbing those around you.
title: Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K (newest model), simple 4K streaming, new Fire TV Remote, all your apps in one place, free & live TV, find shows faster with Alexa+
